summary: Artelo Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $6.53 million of common stock through H.C. Wainwright as sales agent. Sales will be made at market prices under Rule 415(a)(4), with a 3.0% commission. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under an existing registration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other event is present. The ATM program provides capital-raising flexibility but does not constitute a transformative corporate event. Watch for dilution as shares are sold over time, but no near-term catalyst or risk-arb angle exists.
